createAuthorization.name: createAuthorization
createAuthorization.description: Creates an authorization for a merchant. With a non-empty idempotency_key, retrying the same request returns the original authorization, including a failed result. Reusing the key with changed request details returns a conflict. Concurrent requests with the same key create one authorization.

arguments.name: merchant_uid
arguments.description: The Pay Theory unique identifier assigned to the merchant that the authorization belongs to.

arguments.name: idempotency_key
arguments.description: Optional caller-provided key for identifying retries of this authorization request.

arguments.name: sale_id
arguments.description: The Pay Theory unique identifier assigned to the sale that the authorization belongs to. Sales can be used to tie together multiple auths and captures.

arguments.name: amount
arguments.description: The amount of the authorization in cents.

arguments.name: payment_method_id
arguments.description: The Pay Theory unique identifier assigned to the payment method that will be used for the authorization.

arguments.name: payment_method
arguments.description: The payment method input object for the payment method that will be used for the authorization. More information on the payment method input object can be found here.

arguments.name: invoice_id
arguments.description: The Pay Theory unique identifier assigned to the invoice that the authorization belongs to.

arguments.name: fee
arguments.description: The amount of the service fee in cents.

arguments.name: fee_mode
arguments.description: The fee mode for the authorization. It can be one of the following: SERVICE_FEE, MERCHANT_FEE

arguments.name: account_code
arguments.description: Custom defined value passed in as the account code for the authorization.

arguments.name: reference
arguments.description: Custom defined value passed in as the reference for the authorization.

arguments.name: metadata
arguments.description: Any additional data that should be stored with the authorization.

arguments.name: health_expense_type
arguments.description: The health expense type for the authorization. It can be one of the following: CLINICAL, COPAY, DENTAL, HEALTHCARE, RX, TRANSIT, VISION

arguments.name: additional_purchase_data
arguments.description: Additional purchase data for Level 3 processing requirements.

arguments.name: one_time_use_token
arguments.description: If the payment method token should be used for a single transaction. Defaults to false. If set to true the is_active flag on the payment method will be set to false after the authorization.

examples.name: Create an authorization with an idempotency key
examples.description: Places a hold on a card. Use a new key for each new authorization, and reuse it only to retry this request.
examples.query:
mutation CreateAuthorization(
  $merchant_uid: String!
  $amount: Int!
  $idempotency_key: String
  $payment_method: PaymentMethodInput
  $fee_mode: FeeMode
) {
  createAuthorization(
    merchant_uid: $merchant_uid
    amount: $amount
    idempotency_key: $idempotency_key
    payment_method: $payment_method
    fee_mode: $fee_mode
  ) {
    authorization_id
    merchant_uid
    amount
    currency
    status
    fee_mode
    fees
    authorization_date
    expiration_date
    sale_id
  }
}

createCapture.name: createCapture
createCapture.description: This mutation will capture an authorization for a merchant.

arguments.name: merchant_uid
arguments.description: The Pay Theory unique identifier assigned to the merchant that the authorization belongs to.

arguments.name: authorization_id
arguments.description: The Pay Theory unique identifier assigned to the authorization that you are looking to capture.

arguments.name: amount
arguments.description: The amount of the capture in cents. If auth has a feemode of SERVICEFEE this amount would be the amount without the fee included.

arguments.name: fee
arguments.description: The amount of the service fee in cents. Required if you are capturing an auth that has a feemode of SERVICEFEE.

arguments.name: send_receipt
arguments.description: Can be set to true to send a receipt to the payor.

arguments.name: receipt_description
arguments.description: A custom description that will be displayed on the receipt.

arguments.name: allow_reauth
arguments.description: Whether to allow the capture to be reauthorized in the case that it is expired. If this is set to true Pay Theory will reauthorize the capture if it is expired. If this is set to false or left blank, the capture will fail if it is expired.

arguments.name: allow_exceeded_amount
arguments.description: Whether to allow the capture to exceed the amount of the authorization. If this is set to true Pay Theory will release the hold on the current auth and create a new auth for the amount of the capture. If this is set to false or left blank, the capture will fail if the amount is greater than the amount of the authorization.

arguments.name: split
arguments.description: An array of split objects to distribute the transaction amount to different accounts. The sum of all split amounts must equal the transaction amount.

examples.name: Capture an authorization
examples.description: Captures the amount held by an authorization. You can capture an authorization once, so a partial capture releases the rest.

examples.name: Amount is too high
examples.description: Returns an error when the capture amount exceeds the authorization and reauthorization is not allowed.

errors.message: Amount exceeds authorization amount.

examples.name: Capture above the authorization amount
examples.description: Allows a capture above the original authorization amount by creating a new authorization for the capture.
examples.query:
mutation CreateCapture(
  $merchant_uid: String!

  $allow_exceeded_amount: Boolean
) {
  createCapture(
    merchant_uid: $merchant_uid
    authorization_id: $authorization_id
    amount: $amount
    allow_exceeded_amount: $allow_exceeded_amount
  ) {
    transaction_id
    merchant_uid
    gross_amount
    net_amount
    status
    fee_mode
    authorization_id
  }
}

createTransaction.name: createTransaction
createTransaction.description: Creates a transaction. With a non-empty idempotency_key, retrying the same request returns the original transaction, including a declined result. Reusing the key with changed request details returns a conflict. Concurrent requests with the same key create one transaction. Without a key or with an empty key, repeated requests can create separate transactions. Unicode keys are supported.

arguments.description: The Pay Theory unique identifier for the merchant the transaction is for.

arguments.name: idempotency_key
arguments.description: Optional caller-provided key for identifying retries of this transaction request.

arguments.name: fee_mode
arguments.description: The fee mode on the transaction. SERVICE_FEE charges the fees to the payor. MERCHANT_FEE charges the fees to the merchant. Options are:

arguments.name: account_code
arguments.description: Customer defined account code for the transaction.

arguments.name: reference
arguments.description: Customer defined reference for the transaction.

arguments.name: send_receipt
arguments.description: If the receipt should be sent to the payor. Defaults to false. It is sent to the email address on file with the payment method.

arguments.name: split

createWalletTransaction.name: createWalletTransaction
createWalletTransaction.description: This call is used to create a transaction for a wallet payment via Apple Pay or Google Pay. It works in conjunction with our SDKs to allow you to create a transaction via our API.

arguments.name: app_id
arguments.description: The Pay Theory unique identifier for the application.

arguments.name: merchant_uid
arguments.description: The Pay Theory unique identifier for the merchant the transaction is for.

arguments.name: wallet_type
arguments.description: The type of digital wallet being used. Can be one of: APPLE_PAY, GOOGLE_PAY, CLICK_TO_PAY, SAMSUNG_PAY, VISA_STAGED

arguments.name: digital_wallet_payload
arguments.description: The encrypted payload from the PayTheory SDK containing payment information.

arguments.name: amount
arguments.description: The amount of the transaction in cents.

arguments.name: fee
arguments.description: The amount of the service fee in cents. Required if fee_mode is SERVICE_FEE.

arguments.name: billing_address
arguments.description: The billing address information for the transaction.

arguments.name: payor_id
arguments.description: The Pay Theory unique identifier for the payor making the payment.

arguments.name: payor
arguments.description: The payor information if a new payor needs to be created.

arguments.name: recurring_id
arguments.description: The Pay Theory unique identifier for the recurring payment the transaction is for.

arguments.name: invoice_id
arguments.description: The Pay Theory unique identifier for the invoice the transaction is for.

arguments.name: account_code
arguments.description: Customer defined account code for the transaction.

arguments.name: reference
arguments.description: Customer defined reference for the transaction.

arguments.name: send_receipt
arguments.description: If the receipt should be sent to the payor. Defaults to false. It is sent to the email address on file with the payment method.

arguments.name: receipt_description
arguments.description: The description of the transaction that will be displayed on the receipt.

arguments.name: metadata
arguments.description: Custom defined JSON object to be stored with the transaction.

arguments.name: health_expense_type
arguments.description: The type of health expense for the transaction. Can be one of: CLINICAL, COPAY, DENTAL, HEALTHCARE, RX, TRANSIT, VISION

arguments.name: additional_purchase_data
arguments.description: Additional purchase data for Level 3 processing requirements.

arguments.name: split
arguments.description: An array of split objects to distribute the transaction amount to different accounts. The sum of all split amounts must equal the transaction amount.

examples.name: Invalid wallet payload
